issuing_body: 人工知能戦略本部 (Artificial Intelligence Strategy Headquarters, Government of Japan)
covered_actors: National government and ministries/agencies (国・各府省庁)
Research and development institutions, including universities (研究開発機関・大学)
AI utilizing business operators, developers, providers, and system operators, including overseas operators (活用事業者・AI開発提供事業者・システム運用者・海外事業者)
implementation_notes: Issued under Article 13 of Japan's AI Act (Act No. 53 of 2025), this guideline establishes a non-prescriptive, risk-based, and agile (PDCA) framework encouraging voluntary and proactive compliance by all statutory actors (Articles 4-8 of the AI Act), including overseas business operators. It aligns with the Hiroshima AI Process and ISO/IEC 42001, directs national ministries to appoint AI governance leads (referencing the May 2025 generative AI procurement/use guideline's CAIO role), and commits the government to continuously review and update this guideline and related guidance as AI technology evolves.
